faq1.question: What are your delivery times?
faq1.answer: Timelines vary depending on project complexity. An MVP can be delivered in 2-4 weeks, while a complete application typically requires 2-3 months.

faq2.question: Do you offer post-delivery support?
faq2.answer: Yes, all my projects include a warranty period and I offer maintenance contracts for ongoing support.

faq3.question: Do you work remotely?
faq3.answer: Absolutely! I work with clients worldwide. Modern communication tools enable efficient remote collaboration.

faq4.question: How does payment work?
faq4.answer: Generally in 3 stages: 30% at signing, 40% midway, and 30% upon delivery. Flexible arrangements are possible.
